scope: Current solo-development phase; private Lingvessa GitHub repository
requirement_status: TECHNICAL_BRANCH_PROTECTION_NOT_IMPLEMENTED; accepted operational exception, not technical compliance

sources.clause: Main branch protected; implementation moves through reviewed PRs/commits.

sources.section: 7 Repository, source control and release provenance
sources.clause: Protected main branch; reviewed pull requests.

trace_note: Protection clauses are unnumbered prose. TS-REPO-001 is the related source-control requirement, not a fabricated protection-specific requirement ID.
controls: All implementation work uses implementation/* branches.
Changes enter main through Pull Requests.
Merge only after green hosted CI.
No direct push to main by process.
Owner reviews each milestone PR before merge.
residual_risk: GitHub does not technically prevent bypass of these process rules; owner/admin credentials can bypass the process.
p1_disposition: Does not block readiness for owner acceptance under this explicit owner-approved exception.
rationale: Plan v1.4 §8 p6 and Appendix B p12 require reproducible clean-clone/install/migrate/test/build and foundational code boundaries. Neither makes technical protection a non-waivable P1 hard-exit condition. Plan Approval record p13 explicitly records accepted_exceptions. The owner grants this narrow operational exception; no product invariant, execution order or governing PDF is revised.
review_trigger: Reassess with the owner when solo development ends, repository plan/access changes, or before public/production release review. No automatic extension to production controls.
